drivingQuestion: Does the halakha follow Rabbi Tarfon's בורא נפשות רבות וחסרונן or the other view in the mishna?
outcomeNote: The halakha is not decided between the tanna'im; it is referred to established popular practice, which settles the question in practice.

segments.he: רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר ״בּוֹרֵא נְפָשׁוֹת רַבּוֹת וְחֶסְרוֹנָן״. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא בַּר רַב חָנָן לְאַבָּיֵי, וְאָמְרִי לַהּ לְרַב יוֹסֵף: הִלְכְתָא מַאי? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: פּוֹק חֲזִי מַאי עַמָּא דָּבַר.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabbi Tarfon says:» Over water one recites: «Who creates the many forms of life and their needs. Rava bar Rav Ḥanan said to Abaye, and some say to Rav Yosef: What is the halakha» in this dispute? «He said to him: Go out and observe what the people are doing» and act accordingly.

moves.cueHe: רבי טרפון אומר ״בורא נפשות רבות וחסרונן״

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה רבא בר רב חנן לאביי
moves.summary: asks Abaye — in another version Rav Yosef — which view the halakha follows
moves.about: which view in the mishna's dispute over the blessing after water the halakha follows

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: פוק חזי מאי עמא דבר
moves.summary: sends him to observe common practice rather than ruling between the tanna'im
moves.about: settling the halakha by directing him to observe what the people actually do
